name: grp3-folder-hover-dark
js: (() => { const w=[...document.querySelectorAll('.navgrp .navhistwrap')][0]; if(!w) return; w.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover',{bubbles:true,relatedTarget:document.body})); return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); })()

name: grp4-folded-cream
js: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.navgrprow')][1]; b && b.click(); return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); })()

name: grp5-folder-menu-dark
js: (() => { const w=[...document.querySelectorAll('.navgrp .navhistwrap')][0]; if(!w) return; w.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover',{bubbles:true,relatedTarget:document.body})); const b=w.querySelector('.navhistbtn[aria-haspopup]'); b && b.click(); return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); })()
